newsitem.title: UK: BOOKMAKERS MAKE UK LABOUR HOTTEST EVER FAVOURITES.
newsitem.headline: BOOKMAKERS MAKE UK LABOUR HOTTEST EVER FAVOURITES.

text.p: Bookmakers William Hill on Monday made Britain's opposition Labour Party 1/9 favourites to emerge with the largest number of seats at the May 1 national election.

"Labour are now the hottest favourites they have ever been to win a general election, with the Tories at longer odds than have been offered about them since they came to power," said spokesman Graham Sharpe.
William Hill gave the Conservatives odds of 5/1 with the Liberal Democrats 750/1 to be the biggest party.
In the Conservative leadership stakes, William Hill made deputy premier Michael Heseltine favourite to take over from John Major, slashing the odds on Heseltine from 4/1 to 2/1.
Other contenders are; William Hague and Michael Portillo 3/1; Michael Howard 6/1; Kenneth Clarke 8/1; John Redwood 12/1.
